brief:
Palestinian journalist and writer Rola Jabali has sparked widespread controversy in the United States by sharply criticizing Democratic House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries over his support for Israel, according to Shehab Wire. Jabali accused Jeffries of prioritizing Israeli interests in his political positions despite representing American constituents in Congress.

The remarks have drawn significant attention to ongoing tensions within U.S. political circles regarding Israel policy, particularly among Democratic lawmakers and progressive voices. The criticism reflects broader divisions over how American politicians approach the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the weight they give to competing interests when shaping their public positions on Middle East affairs.
